The '''''Vigilance''''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] under the service of [[Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Admiral]] [[Block]] during the [[19 BBY|final]] [[Standard year|year]] of the [[Clone Wars]]. It was present during the [[Destruction of the Vanqor listening station]], the [[Second battle of Christophsis|Second Battle of Christophsis]],<ref name="Dark Disciple" /> and the [[Battle of Utapau]].<ref name="Episode III" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
